body:
I was prescribed Metaxalone for a strained neck/shoulder muscle from lifting weights. I'm a casual pill user and really enjoy opioids. I was really excited to be given Metaxalone in hopes that I could enjoy them to relax and get some of those good pill-induced feelings. I'm also a fairly careful pill user and cautious about taking too much.
I started with a single 800 mg dose on an empty stomach. I felt nothing. My neck/shoulder felt better but I felt nothing else whatsoever. I went about my day as normal, worked out, ran errands, etc. and felt nothing. The next day I tried another single dose of 800 mg. I went out rock climbing where a clear head and quick reflexes are crucial. Again, I felt nothing other than a lack of pain in my strained muscle.
I'm disappointed to say that I do not enjoy Metaxalone for recreational use. I guess I'll be keeping the rest purely for medical use.
